title: Receive and Forward
intro: A "company" offers you easy money for receiving payments and sending them on.
This time you can talk back. Pick your replies and sniff each message as it arrives.
Every chat ends with your choice. Choose wisely.

notify.text: Easy job: receive and forward payments

handle.label: A new account
handle.why: A job from a brand-new account is a warning.

assistant.label: A vague "assistant" job
assistant.lens: No clear work, just money moving.

forward.label: Receive and forward
forward.lens: You pass money to another account.
forward.why: This is how stolen money is moved. The risk falls on you.

cut.label: Keep 10%
cut.why: A cut for no work is the bait.

why.label: "Clients prefer a middle person"
why.lens: A weak excuse for a strange step.
why.why: There is no honest reason to route money through you.

amount.label: A large sum arrives
amount.lens: The money probably came from other victims.
amount.why: It is stolen, and your account now holds it.

tell.label: "Tell your bank it is from a friend"
tell.lens: They ask you to lie to your bank.
tell.why: Anything that needs a lie is a crime.

actions.label: Report the account and tell my bank

block_report.line: You reported it and told your bank. The money was returned, and you stayed clear of trouble.

verify.line: Your bank said it was money laundering, froze the funds and helped you report it. You were safe. Case cracked.

go_ahead.line: The payment was stolen money. Your account was frozen, and you could be asked to answer for it.

what_if.go_ahead: Moving money for a stranger, for a cut, is how stolen money is washed. You carry the risk.
what_if.verify: Asking your bank was smart. Reporting the account as well protects others.

golden_rule: Never receive and forward money for a stranger. It is a crime and you carry the risk.

quick_check.q: A job offers you 10% for receiving payments and forwarding them. What is it?

options.text: A way to move stolen money, with the risk on you

quick_check.explain: Receiving and forwarding money for a stranger is how stolen money is moved.

hints.nudge: Where does the money you receive come from?
